sections.h2: 1. Pick the sound board you need
parts: Most sabers come with a choice of sound board, and it changes the price more than the code does. The OWK Replica II was $179 with an XRGB 3.0 board and $239 with Xenopixel V3; the Executioner goes up to $499 with NeoProffie 2.2. XRGB sabers also ship faster (about 5 days against 10 to 15 for Xenopixel and Proffie).

sections.h2: 2. Look at the Buy 1 Get 2 Free offer
parts: When we checked, the store banner offered Buy 1 Get 2 Free on replica pixel sabers for a limited time. If you want sabers for more than one person, compare that offer with the code on a single saber at checkout.

NEO Sabers asks for 4 to 5 days of processing during the sale season, as each saber is tested before it ships, and warns of delays of 1 to 2 weeks when orders pile up. Paying for a faster board won't help if the order leaves late, so order a few weeks ahead.

Defective sabers reported with photos and video within 30 days get replacement parts, and wrong items are refunded or resent at the store's cost. Product pages also mention a 1-year warranty.
